newsitem.title: USA: US March S&P 500 pushes to top half of day's range.
newsitem.headline: US March S&P 500 pushes to top half of day's range.

text.p: Feb 7 - U.S. March S&P 500 pushed to the top half of the day's range, recovering amid shortcovering by traders who sold on the earlier collapse. Traders said mood nervous, trading interest brisk. Traders cited buy-stops from 784.50 to 785.00. Session high of 793.75 seen good resistance, traders said.
